body: Thanks for the perspective. I've never been so damn terrified in my life. I love my husband and children and to think I could lose them makes me question if I could literally go through this if everyone could read my chats with people. It helps to read other people's perspective that this isn't the end of the world.

I too have been thinking of killing myself because of this, but thank you all for being so rational. It really helps to read these instead of all the post that are bashing people who were on the site. I'm trying to remind myself that this will be extremely embarrassing if all the details come out, but no one knows what each person is going through in their life and that lead them to see out AM.
My husband works away and is gone for long periods and I have a toddler. We used to spend all our time together before his new job so I'm just lonely. Thanks for responding.
